hotspots.title: Indian Place Value System
hotspots.popover_content: Lakh = 10^5, Crore = 10^7. Commas placed after 3 digits from right, then every 2 digits.

hotspots.title: International Place Value System
hotspots.popover_content: Million = 10^6, Billion = 10^9. Commas placed every 3 digits. 1 Crore = 10 Millions.

hotspots.title: Factor Shortcuts (x5 and x25)
hotspots.popover_content: N * 5 = (N / 2) * 10. N * 25 = (N / 4) * 100. Halve and scale by 10, or quarter and scale by 100.

hotspots.title: Sequential Digit Position Analytics
hotspots.popover_content: Digits 1-9 take 9 positions; 10-99 take 180 positions. Finding position 100 yields digit 5.
